title.narrative: Enhancing School Management and Planning Project

description.narrative: The purpose of the Enhancing School Management and Planning Project is to improve the existing management systems and procedures used by the GOJ (through the MPWH and MOE) for the planning, construction, and utilization of public schools in Jordan.
